findings.message: The field lookup goes through FieldByNameFunc and then calls v.Type().FieldByName inside the closure for every field, which is a roundabout way to select one field and repeats a reflection lookup per field.
findings.fix: Replace the closure with a direct loop over the struct type: iterate i from 0 to t.NumField() with t := v.Type(), read f := t.Field(i), and when f.Tag.Get("expr") equals fieldName, or the tag is empty and f.Name equals fieldName, set value = v.Field(i) and break. This uses the StructField already in hand and needs no second lookup.

findings.message: The switch on the tag with a discarded-error lookup and a separate empty-tag branch is more branching than the rule needs.
findings.fix: Collapse the switch into one condition: tag := f.Tag.Get("expr"); match := tag == fieldName || (tag == "" && f.Name == fieldName). Use that single boolean in the loop instead of a switch.
